paragraphs: Alignment Healthcare was founded in 2013 with one mission: improve healthcare, one senior at a time. We pursue this mission by focusing on our core values:
•always put the senior first; •support the doctor; •use data and technology to revolutionize care; and

We created Alignment after our own families faced frustrating experiences within the fragmented healthcare system. Without an advocate to create an integrated, high quality healthcare experience for them, our loved ones were left to navigate a care delivery and insurance landscape fraught with confusion and complexity. Seniors across the country are systemically and disproportionately impacted by the lack of care coordination, transparency and clear information. Furthermore, they are disadvantaged by misaligned incentives that dominate today's healthcare system. As one of our most vulnerable populations, seniors across America need and deserve better. We put our combined decades of healthcare experience to work to create the Alignment model, incorporating best practices learned over our years serving seniors. Through the combination of this experienced, mission-driven team with purpose-built technology, we have found a way to address the unmet health and wellness needs of seniors. We aim to bring this senior-first healthcare experience to millions in the United States, become the most trusted senior healthcare brand in the country, and ultimately "do well by doing good."

Alignment is a next generation, consumer-centric and clinically focused platform designed to improve the healthcare experience for seniors enrolled in Medicare who choose a private Medicare Advantage plan. Our goal is to provide seniors with easier access to care, better coordination among providers, fewer gaps in care and avoidable hospital visits, and support that meets them where they are—at home, online, or in their community. We deliver this experience through our wide variety of Medicare Advantage plans, which offer varied benefits tailored to the diverse needs, preferences, and lifestyles of seniors. We believe our plans are differentiated because of our unique ability to manage costs by delivering proactive care and manage chronic conditions through an integrated clinical and technology model.

Our licensed Medicare Advantage plans contract directly with the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services. In exchange for a capitated, fixed monthly payment for each enrolled member (i.e., revenue per member per month or "PMPM") , we take responsibility for coordinating and managing our members' healthcare—both their health outcomes and the total costs of their care. The PMPM payment varies based on the geography where members live, the health needs and risks of the population we serve, and the quality performance of our plans based on CMS Star Ratings.

Most members enroll with Alignment for a one-year period that can be renewed annually. Because a large majority of our members choose to stay with Alignment after their initial selection year, this model provides meaningful visibility into our short-term financial performance and supports long-term stability and growth.

We have grown Health Plan Membership, which we define as members enrolled in our health maintenance organization ("HMO") and preferred provider organization ("PPO") contracts (the "Alignment Health Plan"), from approximately 13,000 at inception to 236,300 as of December 31, 2025, representing a 30% compound annual growth rate.

For the 2025 plan year, Alignment offered Medicare Advantage plans in 45 markets across California (22 markets), North Carolina (16 markets), Nevada (2 markets), Arizona (3 markets) and Texas (2 markets). These markets collectively include approximately 8.4 million Medicare-eligible seniors.

Under Medicare Advantage's capitated PMPM value-based payment model, we are responsible for delivering and coordinating all covered healthcare services for our members. This obligation includes hospital and physician care under Medicare Parts A and B, prescription drugs under Medicare Part D (with a separate PMPM payment from CMS), the supplemental benefits, such as dental and vision, we offer under certain of our plans, and related administration costs and services.

Unlike the original Medicare program administered by CMS, which we refer to herein as "Traditional Medicare," which typically pays providers separately for each service delivered (i.e., "fee-for-service"), the Medicare Advantage program rewards value rather than volume. By taking responsibility for the overall cost and quality of care for our members, plans like Alignment are incentivized to focus on prevention, care coordination and timely intervention. We meet this challenge by providing proactive, cross-disciplinary care

targeted at reducing avoidable emergency room visits, managing and promoting access to high-value prescription drugs and supporting care transitions after hospital stays, all of which can reduce the need for more expensive institutional treatments and services.

The Medicare Advantage regulatory framework is designed to reward plans that achieve the triple aim of high-quality care, low costs and better experience. CMS payments to Medicare Advantage plans are allocated in each county or region based on a bidding system. Each year, Medicare Advantage plans submit bids based on estimated costs per enrollee for services covered under Medicare Parts A and B. CMS compares those bids to local, county-level benchmarks that reflect what it would cost Traditional Medicare to cover the same population. Plans that have a lower cost structure and are able to deliver care more efficiently generate savings, a portion of which is returned to the plan in the form of rebates with the remainder accruing to CMS and the federal government.

These savings allow high-performing plans to offer enhanced supplemental benefits—such as lower cost sharing, $0 premium Part D coverage, and additional supplemental services—at no additional cost to the senior.

CMS also evaluates Medicare Advantage plans through a Five Star Quality Rating System, which measures clinical outcomes, patient experience, and operational performance. Medicare Advantage plans with higher Star Ratings receive additional economic incentives and payments. In practice, this means that only plans that consistently deliver better care and better member experience at lower cost can sustainably offer richer benefits and grow membership on a long-term basis.

paragraphs: Our business involves a high degree of risk. You should carefully consider the risks and uncertainties described below, together with all of the other information contained in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including our consolidated financial statements and the related notes thereto, before making a decision to invest in our common stock. The risks and uncertainties described below are not the only ones we face. Additional risks and uncertainties that we are unaware of, or that we currently believe are not material, may also become important factors that affect us. If any of the following risks occur, our business, financial condition, operating results and prospectus could be materially and adversely affected. In that event, the price of our common stock could decline, and you could lose all or part of your investment.

The following are the principal risks that are applicable to our business and the shares of our common stock. Such risks are discussed in more detail below, and you should read this Risk Factors section in its entirety before deciding whether to invest in our common stock.
•We have a history of net losses and may be unable to achieve or maintain profitability.
•Our growth strategy may not prove viable and we may not realize expected results.
•If we are unable to attract new members, our revenue growth will be adversely affected.

•If we do not design and price our products properly and competitively, cannot develop new products and implement clinical initiatives, lower costs, and appropriately document members' risk profile, or if our benefits expense estimates are inadequate, our profitability may be materially adversely affected.

Alignment is a next generation, consumer-centric and clinically focused platform designed to improve the healthcare experience for seniors. We deliver this experience through our Medicare Advantage plans, which are customized to meet the needs of a diverse array of seniors. Our innovative model of consumer-centric healthcare is purpose-built to provide seniors with care as it should be: high quality, low cost and accompanied by a vastly improved consumer experience. We combine a proprietary technology platform and a high-touch clinical model that enhances our members' lifestyles and health outcomes while simultaneously controlling costs, which allows us to reinvest savings back into our platform and products to directly benefit the senior consumers.

We have grown Health Plan Membership, which we define as members enrolled in our health maintenance organization ("HMO") and preferred provider organization ("PPO") contracts (the "Alignment Health Plan"), from approximately 13,000 at inception to 236,300 as of December 31, 2025, representing a 30% compound annual growth rate across 45 markets and 5 states. Our ultimate goal is to bring this differentiated, advocacy-driven healthcare experience to millions of senior consumers in the United States and to become the most trusted senior healthcare brand in the country.

For the 2025 plan year, Alignment offered plans in 45 markets across California (22 markets), North Carolina (16 markets), Nevada (2 markets), Arizona (3 markets) and Texas (2 markets). There are approximately 8.4 million Medicare-eligible seniors in our current markets.

Our unique clinical model, led by employed clinical teams known as Care Anywhere, acts upon insights derived from our proprietary technology platform, AVA. This integration between our technology and employed care model is a key element of our business with capabilities that we expect to impact our future performance. AVA's data insights, combined with the clinical control of our care model, enable us to personalize and manage our member relationships, care quality, and to coordinate and manage risk with our provider partners. AVA's unified platform, analytical tools and data across the healthcare ecosystem enable us to produce consistent outcomes, unit economics and support new member growth. Additionally, our historical financial performance has been, and we expect our financial performance in the future will be, driven by our ability to:

•Capitalize on Our Existing Market Growth Opportunity: Our ability to attract and retain members to grow in our existing markets depends on our ability to offer a superior value proposition. We routinely take market share from large established players in highly competitive markets, a key source of our health plan membership growth in excess of the industry average. We believe that there are still significant opportunities for future growth even in some of our most mature markets where we have approximately 10-30% market share. As of January 1, 2026, we have approximately 275,300 Health Plan Members, which, according to CMS data, represent only 6% market share of Medicare Advantage enrollees in our markets.

•Drive Growth and Consistent Outcomes Through New Market Expansion: As part of our long-term growth strategy, we may enter new markets with the goal of building brand awareness across our key stakeholders to achieve meaningful market share over time. We intend to focus on markets with significant senior populations where we expect to be able to replicate our model most effectively. Our existing markets also feature a diverse array of membership profiles across ethnicities, income levels and acuity. Since 2020, we have expanded into 29 markets and four states.

•Provide Superior Service, Care and Consumer Satisfaction: We are highly focused on providing superior service and care to our members and on maintaining high levels of consumer satisfaction, which are key to our financial performance and growth. The CMS Five Star Quality Rating System provides economic incentives to Medicare Advantage plans that achieve higher Star ratings by (i) meeting certain care criteria (such as completing particular preventative screening procedures or ensuring proper follow-up care is provided for specific conditions or episodes) and (ii) receiving high member satisfaction ratings. These incentives impact financial performance in the year following the CMS Rating Year (for example, CMS's announcement of the 2026 Ratings occurred in the second half of 2025 and will impact our financial performance in 2027). One hundred percent of our health plan members are enrolled in plans rated 4 stars and above, meaning our members consistently receive a high-quality care experience, as defined under CMS star measurement criteria. The California HMO plan has achieved a 4 star or greater rating for nine consecutive years.

•Effectively Manage the Quality of Care to Improve Member Outcomes: Our care delivery model is based on a clinical continuum through which we have created a highly personalized experience that is unique to each member depending on their personal health and circumstances. Utilizing data and predictive analytics generated by AVA, our clinical continuum separates seniors into four categories in order to provide optimized care for every stage of a senior's life: healthy, healthy utilizer, pre-chronic and chronic. We partner with our broader network of community providers to service members in our non-chronic categories, and we have developed a Care Anywhere program implemented by our internal clinical teams to care for our higher risk and/or chronically ill members. By investing in our members' care proactively, our model has consistently reduced unnecessary and costly care while improving the quality of our members' lifestyle and healthcare experience. By delivering superior care and preventing avoidable utilization of the healthcare system, we are able to reduce our claims expenditures in some of our largest medical expense categories, which translates to superior medical benefits ratio ("MBR") financial performance and ultimately the ability to offer richer products in the market.

•Achieve Superior Unit Economics: As our senior population ages, their healthcare needs become more frequent and complex. To combat the healthcare cost increases that typically result, we proactively look to (i) connect with our population early in their enrollment with Alignment to assess their care needs, (ii) develop care plans and engage those members with more chronic, complex health challenges in our clinical model, and (iii) continue to monitor and evaluate our healthier members in a preventative fashion over time. Given the Medicare Advantage payment mechanism and the retention of the vast majority of our members who continue to choose Alignment after their initial selection year, we are able to focus our efforts on driving favorable long-term health outcomes for our entire population. As a result, our clinical model efforts have demonstrated the ability to lower the MBRs of our returning members. We believe this is evidence of our ability to manage the financial risk of our members as they age, and that these favorable underlying unit economic trends translate directly to our ability to continue to deliver a richer product to the marketplace. With this dynamic in mind, our consolidated MBR may be impacted year-to-year based on our pace of new member growth and mix of members by cohort. However, we believe our ability to sustain MBR performance improvement over time positions us well to invest in new member growth to drive long-term financial performance.

•Invest in our Platform and Growth: We plan to continue to invest in our business in order to further develop our AVA platform, pursue new expansion opportunities and create innovative product offerings. In addition, in order to maintain a differentiated value proposition for our members, we continue to invest in innovative product offerings and supplemental benefits to meet the evolving needs of the senior consumer. We anticipate further investments in our business as we expand into new markets and pursue strategic acquisitions, which we expect will primarily be focused on healthcare delivery groups in key geographies, standalone and provider-sponsored Medicare Advantage plans and other complementary risk bearing assets.

•Navigate Seasonality to our Business: Our operational and financial results will experience some variability depending upon the time of year in which they are measured. We experience the largest portion of member growth during the first quarter, when plan enrollment selections made during the annual enrollment period ("AEP") from October 15th through December 7th of the prior year take effect. As a result, we expect to see a significant percentage of our member growth occur on January 1 of a given calendar year. As the year progresses, our per-member revenue often declines as new members join us, typically with less complete or accurate documentation (and therefore lower risk-adjustment scores), and senior mortality disproportionately impacts our higher-acuity (and therefore greater revenue) members. Medical costs will vary seasonally depending on a number of factors, but most significantly the seasons. Certain illnesses, such as the influenza virus, are far more prevalent during colder months of the year, which will result in an increase in medical expenses during these time periods. We therefore expect to see higher levels of per-member medical costs in the first and fourth quarters. The design of our prescription drug coverage (Medicare Part D) results in coverage that varies as a member's cumulative out-of-pocket costs pass through successive stages of a member's plan period, which begins annually on January 1 for renewals. Starting in 2025, the benefit redesign under the Inflation Reduction Act resulted in more moderate seasonality than we have experienced in past years. Members still pass through the benefit phases, but our share of the total liability is more consistent through each phase than it has been in the past. In addition, we expect our corporate, general and administrative expenses to increase in absolute dollars for the foreseeable future to support our growth. Due to the timing of many of these investments, including our primary sales and marketing season, we typically incur a greater level of investment in the second half of the year relative to the first half of the year.

paragraphs: Alignment Healthcare 於 2013 年成立，其唯一使命為：改善醫療照護，一次一位長者。我們透過聚焦於我們的核心價值觀來追求此使命：
•始終以長者為先；•支持醫生；•運用數據與科技來革新照護；以及

我們在自己的家庭面臨醫療體系中令人沮喪的經驗後創立了 Alignment。在缺乏倡導者為他們創造整合、高品質醫療照護經驗的情況下，我們的親愛家人都被迫在充滿混淆與複雜的照護交付與保險環境中自行摸索。美國各地的長者系統性且不成比例地受到缺乏照護協調、透明度與清晰資訊的影響。此外，他們也因當前醫療體系中不一致的動機而處於劣勢。作為美國最脆弱的人口之一，長者們需要且應得更好的醫療照護。我們將我們合併的數十年醫療照護經驗投入實踐，以建立 Alignment 模式，並納入我們多年服務長者所學到的最佳實務。透過這個經驗豐富、使命導向的團隊與專為此目的設計的科技結合，我們找到解決長者未被滿足的健康與 wellness 需求的方法。我們的目標是將這種以長者為先的醫療照護經驗帶給美國數百萬人，成為該國最受信賴的長者醫療品牌，並最終 "透過做好事來獲得好處。"

Alignment 是一個新一代、以消費者為中心且以臨牀為導向的平台，旨在改善選擇私人 Medicare Advantage 計畫的 Medicare 受保長者的醫療照護經驗。我們的目標是為長者提供更簡便的照護存取、提供提供者之間更好的協調、減少照護缺口與可避免的醫院訪問，並在他們的家中、線上或社區中提供符合他們需求的支持。我們透過我們廣泛的 Medicare Advantage 計畫來提供此經驗，這些計畫提供多樣化的福利，以符合長者多樣化的需要、偏好與生活方式。我們相信我們的計畫之所以獨特，是因為我們獨特的能力透過整合的臨牀與科技模式來管理成本，並透過主動照護與管理慢性病來實現。

我們的 Medicare Advantage 計畫經許可後直接與美國醫療保險與醫療援助中心（Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services）簽訂契約。我們以每位受保成員每月固定金額（即每位受保成員每月收入或 "PMPM"）換取責任，為我們的成員協調並管理其醫療照護—包括他們的健康結果與他們照護的總成本。PMPM 支付金額會根據成員居住的地理區域、我們服務人口的健康需求與風險，以及根據 CMS 星級評分的計畫品質表現而有所不同。
大多數成員會在 Alignment 註冊一年的期間，此期間可每年續約。因為我們的大多數成員在初始選擇年後選擇繼續與 Alignment 合作，此模式為我們提供對短期財務表現的有意義視野，並支持長期的穩定與成長。
我們的健康計畫成員數（我們定義為 enrollees 在我們的健康維護組織（"HMO"）與優先提供者組織（"PPO"）契約（"Alignment Health Plan"）中）已從成立時的約 13,000 人成長至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的 236,300 人，代表年複合成長率為 30%。
在 2025 年計畫年，Alignment 在加利福尼亞州（22 市場）、北卡羅來納州（16 市場）、內華達州（2 市場）、亞利桑那州（3 市場）和德克薩斯州（2 市場）共 45 市場提供 Medicare Advantage 計畫。這些市場合計約有 840 萬位 Medicare 合格長者。
根據 Medicare Advantage 的按人均每月金額（PMPM）價值-based 支付模式，我們需為成員提供並協調所有覆蓋的醫療服務。此義務包括 Medicare Parts A 和 B 覆蓋的醫院與醫師照護、Medicare Part D 覆蓋的處方藥（與 CMS 有獨立的 PMPM 支付），以及我們在某些計劃中提供的補充福利，例如牙科與視力服務，以及相關的行政費用與服務。

與由 CMS 管理的原始 Medicare 程式（我們在此稱為「傳統 Medicare」）不同，傳統 Medicare 通常會針對每項服務獨立支付給提供者（即「按服務計費」模式），而 Medicare Advantage 程式則以價值為導向，而非以服務數量為導向。透過對成員的整體照護成本與品質負起責任，類似 Alignment 的計畫會被激勵著著重於預防、照護協調與及時幹預。我們透過提供主動且跨學科的照護來應對此挑戰
針對減少不必要的急診室訪問、管理並促進高價值處方藥的取得，以及支持住院後的照護轉移，這些措施皆可減少對更昂貴機構治療與服務的需求。

Medicare Advantage 的監管架構設計為獎勵達成「高品質照護、低成本與更佳體驗」三重目標的計畫。CMS 對 Medicare Advantage 計畫的支付，是根據每個縣或地區的競標系統進行分配。每年，Medicare Advantage 計畫會根據預估每位 enrollee 的服務成本提出競標，CMS 會將這些競標與當地縣級的指標進行比較，這些指標反映的是傳統 Medicare 覆蓋相同人口的預估成本。具有較低成本結構且能更有效提供照護的計畫，會產生節省，其中一部分會以折扣回饋給計畫，餘額則歸屬 CMS 與聯邦政府。
這些節省使表現優異的計畫能夠提供增強的補充福利—例如較低的共付額、$0 預付金 Part D 覆蓋，以及額外的補充服務—而對長者來說，不會增加額外成本。
CMS 也會透過五顆星品質評分系統評估 Medicare Advantage 計畫，該系統衡量臨牀結果、患者體驗與運營表現。獲得較高星級評分的 Medicare Advantage 計畫會獲得額外的經濟激勵與支付。實際上，這意味著只有那些能以較低成本持續提供更佳照護與更佳成員體驗的計畫，才能長遠地提供更豐富的福利並擴大成員數量。

paragraphs: 以下討論應與合併財務報表及附註說明一併閱讀，這些財務報表及附註說明載於本年度報告表 10-K 其他部分。本討論包含前瞻性陳述，涉及風險與不確定性。我們實際結果可能與這些前瞻性陳述所預期的有重大差異，原因包括下列討論及本年度報告表 10-K 其他部分所提及的各種因素。請參閱第一部分 第 1A 項 風險因素及有關前瞻性陳述的警示聲明。有關 2023 年項目及 2024 年與 2023 年年對年比較之討論，且未包含於本表 10-K 中，請參閱第七項 "管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之討論與分析"，載於我們 2024 年 12 月 31 日結業年度之年度報告表 10-K，於 2025 年 2 月 27 日提交至證券交易委員會。

Alignment 是一個新一代、以消費者為中心且以臨牀為導向的平台，旨在改善長者之醫療照護體驗。我們透過我們的 Medicare Advantage 計畫來提供此體驗，這些計畫是根據多樣化長者羣體的需求進行客製化。我們創新且以消費者為中心的醫療照護模式，是專為長者設計，提供高品質、低成本且伴隨大幅改善的消費者體驗。我們結合專屬的科技平台與高接觸的臨牀模式，以提升會員的生活品質與健康結果，同時控制成本，使我們能將節省的費用重新投資於平台與產品，直接造福長者消費者。

我們已成長 Health Plan 會員數，我們定義為加入我們健康維護組織（"HMO"）及優先提供者組織（"PPO"）契約（"Alignment Health Plan"）的會員，從約 13,000 人於成立時，成長至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的 236,300 人，代表在 45 個市場及 5 個州的年複合成長率為 30%。我們的最終目標是將這項差異化、倡導導向的醫療照護體驗帶給美國數百萬長者消費者，並成為該國最受信賴的長者醫療品牌。
2025 年計畫年度，Alignment 在加利福尼亞州（22 個市場）、北卡羅來納州（16 個市場）、內華達州（2 個市場）、亞利桑那州（3 個市場）及德克薩斯州（2 個市場）的 45 個市場提供計畫。我們目前市場中約有 840 萬位符合 Medicare 資格的長者。

我們獨特的臨牀模式，由稱為 Care Anywhere 的僱用臨牀團隊領導，根據我們專屬科技平台 AVA 所產生的見解進行行動。我們科技與僱用照護模式之間的整合是我們業務的關鍵要素，我們預期這些能力將影響我們未來的表現。AVA 的數據見解，結合我們照護模式的臨牀控制，使我們能個性化並管理我們的會員關係、照護品質，並與我們的提供者夥伴協調及管理風險。AVA 的統一平台、分析工具及醫療照護生態系中的數據，使我們能產生一致的結果、單位經濟學並支持新會員成長。此外，我們的歷史財務表現已受到，我們預期未來財務表現將受到，我們能：

•把握我們現有市場的成長機會：我們吸引並留住會員以在現有市場成長的能力，取決於我們能否提供優越的價值主張。我們經常從大型已建立的競爭對手手中取得市場份額，這是我們健康計畫會員成長超過產業平均的主要來源。我們相信，即使在一些我們最成熟的市場，我們擁有約 10-30% 的市場份額，仍有顯著的未來成長機會。根據 2026 年 1 月 1 日的資料，我們約有 275,300 名健康計畫會員，根據 CMS 的資料，這僅代表我們市場中 Medicare Advantage 登記者 6% 的市場份額。
•透過新市場擴張推動成長與一致的結果：根據我們的長期成長策略，我們可能進入新市場，目標是建立品牌知名度，以在關鍵利益相關者中實現有意義的市場份額。我們打算專注於有大量長者人口的市場，我們預期能在這些市場中最有效地複製我們的模式。我們現有的市場也包含多樣化的會員人口，包括不同種族、收入層次及病情嚴重程度。自 2020 年以來，我們已擴張至 29 個市場及四個州。

•提供優越的服務、照護與消費者滿意度：我們極度專注於為會員提供優越的服務與照護，並維持高層次的消費者滿意度，這是我們財務表現與成長的關鍵。CMS 五星品質評分系統為 Medicare Advantage 計畫提供經濟誘因，這些計畫若達到較高的星級評分，則會（i）達成特定照護標準（例如完成特定預防篩檢程序或確保特定疾病或事件的適當後續照護）及（ii）獲得高會員滿意度評分。這些誘因會影響下一年的財務表現（例如 CMS 在 2026 年評分的公告於 2025 年第二季公佈，將影響我們 2027 年的財務表現）。我們 100% 的健康計畫會員都加入評分 4 星或以上之計畫，這表示我們的會員持續獲得高品質的照護體驗，符合 CMS 星級評分標準。加利福尼亞州的 HMO 計畫已連續九年獲得 4 星或以上的評分。

•有效管理照護品質以提升會員成果：我們的照護交付模式基於一個臨牀連續體，透過這個模式，我們為每位會員創造了高度個人化的體驗，根據每位會員的個人健康狀況與情境而有所不同。利用AVA產生的資料與預測分析，我們的臨牀連續體將長者分為四類，以提供針對每個長者生命階段的最佳照護：健康、健康使用者、預慢性及慢性。我們與廣泛的社區提供者合作，為非慢性類別的會員提供服務，並已開發出由內部臨牀團隊執行的Care Anywhere計畫，以照顧高風險及/或慢性病會員。透過積極投資會員的照護，我們的模式已持續減少不必要的且成本高昂的照護，同時提升會員的生活品質與醫療體驗。透過提供優質照護並預防醫療系統的非必要使用，我們能夠降低部分最大醫療費用類別的申報支出，這轉化為優越的醫療效益比率（"MBR"）財務表現，最終提升我們在市場上提供更優質產品的能力。

•實現優越的單位經濟效益：隨著長者人口年齡增長，其醫療需求變得更頻繁且複雜。為對抗通常產生的醫療費用增加，我們積極進行（i）在入會初期與會員進行對齊（Alignment）以評估其照護需求，（ii）制定照護計畫並與有更多慢性、複雜健康挑戰的會員在臨牀模式中互動，以及（iii）持續以預防方式監測與評估較健康的會員。根據醫療保險優化支付機制，以及我們絕大多數會員在初始選擇年後仍選擇 Alignment 的情況，我們能夠專注於推動我們整體人口的有利長期健康結果。因此，我們的臨牀模式努力已展現降低迴歸會員的MBR的能力。我們認為這是我們管理會員隨著年齡增長的財務風險的證據，且這些有利的單位經濟趨勢直接轉化為我們持續在市場上提供更優質產品的能力。考慮到這種動態，我們的合併MBR可能根據新會員成長速度與會員組別組成而每年有所變動。然而，我們相信我們持續改善MBR表現的能力，使我們處於良好的位置，以投資新會員成長，推動長期財務表現。
•投資於我們的平台與成長：我們計畫繼續投資於我們的業務，以進一步發展AVA平台、追求新的擴張機會並創造創新產品。此外，為維持我們會員的差異化價值主張，我們持續投資於創新產品與附加福利，以符合長者消費者的演進需求。我們預期在擴張至新市場與追求戰略收購時，會進一步投資於我們的業務，而我們預期這些收購將主要聚焦於關鍵地區的醫療照護羣組、獨立運作與提供者支持的醫療保險優化計畫及其他補充風險承擔資產。

•掌握季節性對業務的影響：我們的營運與財務結果會因測量時間的不同而有所變動。我們在第一季會看到最大的會員成長，這時會有前一年10月15日至12月7日的年度 enrolment 期間（"AEP"）所做選擇的計畫 enrolment 開始生效。因此，我們預期在某個會計年度的1月1日會看到相當大比例的會員成長。隨著時間推進，我們每位會員的收入通常會下降，因為新加入的會員通常文件不完整或不準確（因此風險調整分數較低），且高風險會員的長者死亡率會 disproportionately 影響我們的高風險（因此較高收入）會員。醫療費用會因多種因素而有季節性變動，但最主要的是季節因素。某些疾病，例如流感病毒，在較冷的月份會更加普遍，這會導致這些時期的醫療費用增加。因此，我們預期在第一季和第四季會看到較高的每位會員醫療費用。我們的處方藥覆蓋設計（Medicare Part D）會導致覆蓋範圍隨著會員累計自付費用經過計畫期間的各個階段而變化，計畫期間每年1月1日開始，並於續約時生效。從2025年起，根據《通脹減緩法案》的福利重新設計，我們的季節性會比過去幾年更加溫和。會員仍然會經歷福利階段，但我們在每個階段的總責任比例會比過去更為一致。此外，我們預期在可預見的未來，公司的營運、總體及行政費用會以美元計增加，以支持我們的成長。由於許多這些投資的時間點，包括我們的主要銷售與行銷季節，我們通常在第二季會比第一季有更高的投資金額。
除了依照美國通用會計準則（"U.S. GAAP"）提供的財務資訊外，我們也會評估許多營運與財務指標，包括以下關鍵指標，以評估我們的業務、衡量我們的表現、識別影響我們業務的趨勢、制定業務計畫並做出戰略決策。

paragraphs: 本公司業務涉及高度風險。您應仔細考量下列所描述的風險與不確定性，並配合本年度10-K表報表中所有其他資訊，包括本公司合併財務報表及相關附註，再做是否投資本公司普通股的決定。下列所描述的風險與不確定性並非本公司唯一面臨的風險。尚有其他風險與不確定性，可能是本公司尚未知悉，或目前認為不具重大性，但未來可能成為影響本公司的重要因素。若任何下列風險發生，將可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運成果與前景造成重大且不利的影響。在此情況下，本公司普通股的價格可能下跌，您可能損失全部或部分投資。
下列為適用於本公司業務與本公司普通股的主要風險。這些風險在下文有更詳細說明，您在決定是否投資本公司普通股前，應完整閱讀本風險因素部分。
•本公司有淨虧損的歷史，可能無法達成或維持獲利。
•本公司成長策略可能無法實現，且可能無法達成預期結果。
•若本公司無法吸引新會員，將對營收成長造成不利影響。
•若本公司無法適當設計與定價產品、無法開發新產品並落實臨牀計畫、無法降低成本，或未能正確記錄會員的風險資料，或本公司福利費用預估不足，將可能對獲利造成重大且不利的影響。
